producer_verifier_replay.note: Identical verifier/library/catalog/build-receipt copied to task scratch because verifier writes to its own directory; producer tree remained unchanged.

findings.issue: Census suffix stripping and CDC title-prefix matching emit definitive annual_variant/GIS/geography relation labels without publisher relationship evidence or inferred/candidate state.
findings.required: Preserve these as candidate relations only with explicit inference basis and unresolved publisher identity; enforce source identity, keep exact record/shard/evidence pointers, prohibit canonical merge/release binding. Do not change the100product selection or infer scientific interchangeability.

findings.issue: INTAKE_LIMITS says PR046 and PR049 select pilot entities later, contradicting the C0023 pre-endpoint frozen selection contract.
findings.required: C0023 freezes25hospitals/10payercandidates; PR046/049 consume those IDs and resolve locators without endpoint-driven replacement.

findings.issue: Source-copy observed_at17:33Z predates recovery run start17:35:17Z; rounded other times are not identified as estimates.
findings.required: Preserve the original handoff/hash as failed evidence, use actual captured provider event timestamps or explicitly mark event-unavailable rather than guess. Retain actual command exits and bind exact reviewed commit via an external review receipt.

findings.issue: Independent verifier replay overwrites a committed producer receipt with currentHEAD, invalidating handoff hashes and dirtying the candidate.
findings.required: Support an explicit receipt output path (or read-only default), preserve producer receipts and document exact replay command. Hash the catalog before executing it so the declared integrity check precedes interpretation.

acceptance_scope: C0021 only; C0022/C0023 and allR01-R16 remain unaccepted.
